2. The petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Dhurwa (T) P.S. Case No.65 of 2025
(Sessions Trial Case No.339 of 2025) for the alleged offences registered under Sections 376(2)(n),

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that petitioner is in jail custody since 29.04.2025 and there is no criminal antecedent against the petitioner.

By way of referring to paragraph No.14 of the complaint petition, he submits that the allegations are made that since last 16 years the relationship was --1-- 2025:JHHC:22581 established with the complainant and thereafter the marriage has not been solemnized.

He submits that the petitioner and the victim were in live-in-relationship and she is major aged about 36 years.
4.
Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the case is arising out of 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code.

5. Considering that the petitioner is in custody since 29.04.2024 and there is no criminal antecedent against the petitioner and looking into paragraph No.16 the statement is there that since last 16 years the relationship was established and the girl is said to be aged about 36 years prima facie it appears that both were in live-in-relationship, I am inclined to grant regular bail to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, shall be released on regular bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-VI-cum-Special Judge F.T.C. (CAW),
Ranchi in connection with Dhurwa (T) P.S. Case No.65 of 2025 (Sessions Trial Case No.339 of 2025).

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
